source: Nav’ed Praetis: …Scrolls? Books?
target: 纳维德・普雷蒂斯：……卷轴？书？

source: Leyál: Knowledge, Nav’ed. Knowledge flowing from as far back as your great grandfather Gavin Praetis, who witnessed The Great Collapse. These are his Books of Observation. And this pile – well, you were too young to remember your grandfather Fungaki, but he wrote about your incredible grandmother and kept her writings.
target: 蕾雅：知识，纳维德。远从曾祖父盖文・普雷蒂斯传下来的知识，他亲眼见证大崩溃。这些是他的《观察录》。这一堆呢，你年纪太小，不记得芬加奇爷爷了，但他写下你那非凡祖母的故事，也保存了她的文字。

source: Nav’ed Praetis: But Mamu, what do I do with all of this?
target: 纳维德・普雷蒂斯：可是妈妈，这些东西，我该拿来做什么？

source: Leyál: Open your ears, my boy, and listen. Do you remember those great fires in the city seven years ago, when the air was hot with ash for three days? The Massuma Empire crumbled from civil war. Many people chose not to rebuild as the Snail Diviners began ruling these lands through superstition and violence. Our palace, our titles, the very clothes in our closets were taken… do you remember how you cried for your toy snails? I traded my jewelry for this simple hut close to the pine forest… or what’s left of it. But the real treasures I hid in my robes and rolled up floor rugs.
target: 蕾雅：张开耳朵，孩子，听好。记得七年前城里的大火吗？空气烧烫，灰烬飘了三天。马苏玛帝国在内战中崩溃。蜗卜师开始用迷信与暴力统治，许多人便不愿重建。宫殿、头衔，连柜里衣服都被夺走……记得你为玩具蜗牛哭泣吗？我拿珠宝，换了松林附近这间小屋……至少那里还剩些松林。但真正的宝藏，我藏在袍子和卷起的地毯里。

source: Leyál: My dear, it’s up to you what to do. But the real trick is remembering. I hardly recognize our world anymore. The world of mud and money is now dry of both. I’m not sure how, but I’m convinced this knowledge before us will help you in this broken world. Just look at this lovely little song from Gavin’s book. Imagine, making biscuit bread out of pine tree bark…
target: 蕾雅：亲爱的，做什么由你决定。但真正的诀窍，是记住。我几乎不认得这世界了。从前满是泥与钱，如今两者都干涸。不知道会怎样，但我相信眼前的知识，能在破碎世界里帮你。看看盖文书里这首可爱的小歌。想像一下，用松树皮做饼干面包……

source: Leyál: Sit, my dear. It’s all a promise. A promise I made to your father. May Emya and Snahoon watch him. You’re old enough now to begin a great learning as my sun is setting.
target: 蕾雅：坐下，亲爱的。这全是一个承诺，我对你父亲的承诺。愿艾米雅与斯纳洪守护他。你已够大，可以开始伟大的学习，而我的太阳正要落下。

source: Nav’ed Praetis: Mamu, I fetched the pine bark you asked for but does bread actually—why are you out of bed? What’s all this on the floor?
target: 纳维德・普雷蒂斯：妈妈，妳要的松树皮拿来了，可面包真的能——妳怎么下床了？地上这些是什么？

source: Nav’ed Praetis: Don’t speak like this, Mamu!
target: 纳维德・普雷蒂斯：妈妈，别这样说！

source: Leyál: This was a letter from her to your father Kwyn. Your grandmother Daneve was also taken away by brutally ambitious people. Ah, yes. Your father’s maps and artifact logs, when he had the time to feed his passions. All of your ancestors mention this Quentin Brown oracle… he sounds rather wise.
target: 蕾雅：这是她写给你父亲奎恩的信。祖母丹妮芙，也被野心残酷的人带走了。啊，对，父亲的地图与文物纪录，那时他还有时间追求热爱。你所有祖先都提过这位昆汀・布朗先知……听起来很有智慧。

source: What’s he mean by “power generator?” What the snailslop is a “magazine” exactly? Why not just call it a book? What’s the point of hiding the meaning of things in their odd names? Fifth time… fifth time I’m reading through his artifact logs and I just can’t retain the knowledge…. It's like my papu Kwyn was using these dreamed-up words for artifacts instead of describing their ideas. His maps, on the other hand, are perfect. Simple and pure. As knowledge should be. But all this written knowledge is bungled by oddities and faults in our very language. Though, the poetry documents of great grandpapu Gavin Praetis are strange and amusing. Language as music. Vivid and coursing with feeling. Soothes the mind in a way, allowing it to live the words instead of comprehending them. Ah-ha, here it is. A hidden little piece from great grandpapu Gavin’s Book of Observations called the “Quentin Virtues.” Yes, interesting. This is what I will repeat for memorization tonight after I’m home from scribing for the Snail Diviners. The scarce paper we have left in this crumbled city is all used to jot down pointless readings of Gloppa, snail mucus patterns. I’d have my hutt ransacked and these papers seized if anyone found out about them… Without anything to write on, I suppose repetition has been working well enough. I find myself remembering useful information to share with neighbors – edible mushrooms, practical uses for pine sap, stories from the shallow sea and the age before. Word spreads. More and more I’m sought out for what I know, which makes my repetitions important. I have time for a little remembering before work… “Quentin Virtues” “First Virtue: In the past we are found.” “In the past we are found.” “In the past we are found...”
target: 「发电机」是什么意思？「杂志」到底是什么蜗泥？直接叫书不就好了？把事物的意义藏在怪名字里，有什么用？ 第五次……第五次读他的文物纪录，我还是记不住…… 爸爸奎恩仿佛在替文物编造名字，而不是说明概念。他的地图倒是完美，简单、纯粹，知识就该如此。可是这些文字知识，全被语言本身的怪异与缺陷弄乱了。 不过，曾祖父盖文・普雷蒂斯的诗篇，奇妙又有趣。语言成了音乐，鲜明，流动着情感。它以某种方式安抚心灵，让人活在字句里，而非理解字句。 啊哈，找到了。曾祖父盖文《观察录》里藏着一小篇，叫「昆汀美德」。嗯，有意思。今晚替蜗卜师抄写完回家，就反复背这篇。 这座崩毁城市仅剩的纸，全拿去记毫无意义的格洛帕占卜，也就是蜗牛黏液纹路。要是有人知道这些文稿，我的小屋会被抄，纸全没收…… 没东西可写，反复背诵似乎也够用了。我发现自己能记住实用资讯，分享给邻居：可食蘑菇、松脂用途、浅海及更早时代的故事。 消息传开，越来越多人为我所知而来，让反复背诵更加重要。 上工前，还有点时间记忆…… 「昆汀美德」 「第一美德：在过去中，找到我们。」 「在过去中，找到我们。」 「在过去中，找到我们……」

source: No more, no more! Please wind, cease your gale! Let me settle in this… this… night-cooled dust. I need rest, water… How long have I been tossed in the gusts? I remember an otherwise pleasant morning on Mother Tree, dangling and soaking in fresh dew. Then the ground trembled. Nests fell from branches and birds burst from the canopies in frightening numbers. I clung to my home branch... CA-RACK! Unimaginable thunder. The mountains on the horizon suddenly flared, roared black smoke into the sky and spewed rivers of fire. The explosion caused such a great wind that mighty trees were blown bald. I was swept away in that horrible wind, which uprooted plants and flung small animals across distances I didn’t know existed. I was desperate to leave its grasp… I am losing life… What better is this? Dust. Arid, choking dust. Burying me. The only chance… for me… is sleep…
target: 别再吹了，别再吹！风啊，求你停下狂怒！ 让我落在这……这夜里冷却的尘土。我需要休息、水…… 在狂风里翻滚多久了？我记得母树上本来愉快的早晨，悬挂着，吸收新露。然后大地颤抖，鸟巢从枝头掉落，惊人的鸟群冲出树冠。我紧抓家枝…… 轰——裂！难以想像的巨雷。地平线上的山突然迸光，向天空吼出黑烟，喷出火河。爆炸掀起狂风，强壮大树被吹得光秃。我被那可怕的风卷走，植物连根拔起，小动物抛向我从不知道存在的远方。我拼命想逃离掌握……生命正在流失…… 这又好到哪里？尘土，干燥、窒息的尘土，掩埋我。 唯一的机会……对我……是睡……

source: Dark cloud chokes the whole sky. Wind bring bad cloud. Rrrmmm. An entire season now. Smell of smoke and ash. All is dry. Why cloud above silent? No thunder? How wind not move it? Where is sun? Bad omens, more and more. Ground cracked. Dust mixes in air, in water. Grass and bush turn yellow. Birds fall from sky. Coyotes eat their own. Human hunt and take everything they can. My home dying… Rrrrrmmm. This not how I meet death. Not me. I kill the killers. Bear. Crocodile. Hunter. The two-head alpha human I tracked with nose when freed in the tunnels of thier home. I eat their heart. I survive chaos, fight pit, city of clay. I survive great human quarrel and great hot fires. I survive because I fight! Now I eat carcasses of rot. Hunt animal more bone than meat. Drink gray waters. My legs ache. Last eye hazy. This not way to die… Kill me then dark cloud! FIGHT ME! Let me use all strength one more time! Let me thrash my neck, snap my jaw, rip with teeth, poison with tongue! I greatest opponent you ever have! Grant me honor of glorious death! rrrrrrRRROOOHHH! RRRAAH! RRRAAAAAHH! Honor my strength!
target: 黑云堵住整片天。风带坏云。呜噜，整整一季了。烟灰味。全干。头顶云为什么不响？没雷？风怎吹不走？太阳在哪？ 坏兆头越来越多。地裂，尘进空气，进水。草和灌木黄了，鸟从天掉，郊狼吃同类。人类猎，拿光能拿的。家在死…… 呜噜噜。我不能这样死。不是我。我杀猎杀者。熊，鳄鱼，猎人。在他们家地道被放出来后，靠鼻子追上的双头人头领。我吃他们的心。我活过混乱、斗坑、黏土城，活过人类大争斗、大热火。我活，因为我打！ 现在吃烂尸，猎骨比肉多的动物，喝灰水。腿痛，最后一只眼朦胧。不能这样死…… 黑云，那就杀我！跟我打！ 让我再用一次全力！甩颈，咬腭，牙撕，舌毒！我是你最强的对手！赐我光荣战死的荣耀！ 呜——吼！吼啊！吼啊——！ 敬我的力量！

source:
Bear witness to this pine forest, the fields yonder, the cresting mount before us as sacred as Sinai. This is divine providence. 

Why here? Ye be reminded: 

‘Tis the domain of White. The realm of Purity. 

Two years ago I doth sought His light on a journey pious through His virgin green Kingdom. Across pasture and forest and mountain I stumbled and bled. The Devil tempted me with memory of comforts lost, and in moments of ill-wit I near set back. Then, ‘twas at this very pulpit in our daisy field of worship that I saw the White Raccoon with its fur of burning light. I fell to my knees and I wept. I understood that this Eden is where we, fellow repenters, are closest to God. 

I ask thee, taketh to heart the daisy flower. Though it bears a sickly and bruised yellow center, it resonates petals of White – the angel-color of purity that is found only in
target:
看这松林、远处田野、眼前如西奈般神圣的山巅。此乃神的恩典。

为何在此？诸位当记得：

此乃白色之境，纯洁之域。

两年前，我虔诚踏入祂未受玷污的翠绿国度，寻求圣光。穿越草场、森林、山岳，一路跌撞流血。魔鬼以失去的安逸诱惑我，意志薄弱之际，我几乎折返。就在这里，我们敬拜的雏菊田、这座讲坛前，我看见白浣熊，皮毛如燃烧的光。我跪地哭泣，明白这片伊甸，正是我们悔罪者最接近上帝的地方。

请将雏菊铭记于心。花心虽黄得病弱瘀伤，花瓣却散发白光——天使般纯洁的色彩，唯见于

source:
Banished for our beliefs by wicked men from the Northern Colonies, we are delivered hither by His Divine Hand. Holdfast thine faith, for God shalt reckon upon their ruin and misery for they rejected nature. They rejected His plans for beast and wilderness. They rejected the covenant of life between Creation and Man.

They flattered themselves to believe they can “tame satanic nature.” What nobility is there to civilization if it begets destruction? ‘Tis the pleasure of the Devil to see Creation’s death. Certainly, a gaping hell awaits as their sole refuge, for those who live by hellfire’s destruction shalt meet it.
target:
北方殖民地的恶人因我们的信仰，将我们放逐；祂的圣手却引领我们到此。坚守信仰，上帝必使他们毁灭受苦，因他们拒绝自然，拒绝祂对野兽与荒野的安排，拒绝造物与人之间的生命盟约。

他们自鸣得意，以为能「驯服撒旦般的自然」。若文明带来毁灭，何来高贵？看见造物死亡，正合魔鬼心意。敞开的地狱必是他们唯一归宿，因以地狱烈火之毁灭为生者，终将迎上烈火。

source:
Creation’s miracles, such as white raccoons. This flower is our symbol. The symbol of the covenant of His Word, that we Sinners who abide by the Purity of Creation and reject the hastening of its destruction can thus be redeemed to resonate its purity.  

Behold your yellowed, sinful heart. Unfurl it with petals of repentance. Hold dear the daisy flower and let our land blaze with its good White.
target:
造物的奇迹，譬如白浣熊。这朵花是我们的象征，是祂圣言盟约的象征：我们罪人若遵循造物的纯洁，拒绝加速其毁灭，便能得救，映照其纯洁。

看你发黄、有罪的心，以悔罪花瓣将它展开。珍惜雏菊，让我们的土地，燃起它良善的白光。

source: HEAR MY SCORN
target: 聆听我的怨愤

source: Mercy, God. Mercy. Mercy. I pray for thine unmerited mercy for mine pain breaks me… Forgive the limits of my corrupted faculties, and show me Word… guide my eyes to Scripture that would soothe the anguish of my heart. On bended knee I beseech thee for clarity of my purpose… IT CANNOT BE THAT I WAS DESTINED TO BE THE HARBINGER OF SIN TO BANCROFT! I-I had little choice. Our plight… God... Savages scalped our wives in our wheat fields. Took our children from our gardens. Starved us from game and hunt in the frigid winter. They thought us murderous trappers, descendants of those who killed one of theirs called “Brave Wind!” Absurd! Every last soul would have perished were it not for the protection of the Crown. And so, by no motivation of greed or want, I offered our settlement to His Majesty who thus granted royal charter. When did we deviate from Thine path? Did we sully Thine Eden? I dwell on these wretched thoughts as my weeping eyes witness sin that spreadeth great and undying, like plague... The royal soldiers bring drink and whoring. The traders bring markets and greed. Greed brings conflict, bloodshed, and the very horror we had long rejected: the thoughtless destruction of Nature and Thine Creation. What… WHAT DIVINE PLAN IS THIS? Where is Thine Son Jesus to upturn the merchant’s tables and take back His temple? Are our spirits unworthy of salvation? My faith… Mercy. Grant mercy for this miserable daisy, my God. One that is all sickly yellow, shaken of its pure, white petals….
target: 怜悯，上帝。怜悯，怜悯。 我祈求不配得的怜悯，痛苦正将我击碎…… 原谅我腐败心智的局限，向我显明圣言……引导双眼看见能抚慰心痛的经文。我屈膝恳求，看清自己的使命…… 我绝不可能注定成为把罪恶带进班克罗夫特的先驱！ 我、我别无选择。我们的困境……上帝……野人在麦田剥下妻子的头皮，从菜园掳走孩子，在寒冬断绝我们狩猎，让我们挨饿。他们把我们当杀人的捕兽者，当作杀害一名叫「勇风」族人的凶手后代！荒谬！ 若非王室保护，每个人都会死。因此，不为贪婪，不为欲望，我将聚落献给陛下，获授皇家特许。 何时偏离祢的道路？我们玷污了祢的伊甸吗？泪眼见罪恶如瘟疫般蔓延不灭，我反复困于这些痛苦念头…… 皇家士兵带来饮酒与嫖娼。商人带来市场与贪婪。贪婪带来冲突、流血，以及我们长久拒绝的恐怖：不假思索地摧毁自然，摧毁祢的造物。 这……算什么神圣计划？祢的儿子耶稣在哪里？为何不掀翻商人的桌子，夺回圣殿？我们的灵魂不配得救吗？ 我的信仰…… 怜悯。我的上帝，怜悯这朵悲惨雏菊吧。它只剩病黄的花心，纯白花瓣已全被震落……

source: <color=#DB6258>M</color><size=20>ERCIFUL</size> <color=#DB6258>C</color><size=20>HRIST</size>
target: <color=#DB6258>仁</color><size=20>慈的</size><color=#DB6258>基</color><size=20>督</size>

source: Brave Wind: What does this mea— AYYY! My watali!
target: 勇风：这是什么意——啊！我的watali！

source: Good Nose: So what?
target: 好鼻：那又怎样？

source: Brave Wind: Ni, ni! Did you see the long tail of that falling star?
target: 勇风：Ni, ni！看见流星的长尾巴了吗？

source: Brave Wind: Unili, up there in the sky, do you see Ani Tsutsa – Seven Brothers? These stars move each night… but really, they never move.
target: 勇风：Unili，在天上，你看得见Ani Tsutsa——七兄弟吗？星星每晚都动……其实却从不动。

source: Good Nose: I cannot see it, but my hand is bound to a path right now…
target: 好鼻：看不见，可我的手现在倒被绑在一条路上……

source: Good Nose: Ehehe, you chew some yopo with your big brother and now you are high up on the mountain, eh?
target: 好鼻：嘿嘿，跟哥哥嚼点尤波，就飘上高山了，嗯？

source: Good Nose: OOOM — you little bisonshit! Errrmm… you never… errm… strike a man’s watali!
target: 好鼻：呜——你这小牛粪！呃……不许……呃……打男人的watali！

source: Brave Wind: It is strange. The stars move every night up across elohi, but in greater time, they stay on a circle-path. From last summer to now, they do not go anywhere.
target: 勇风：很奇怪。每晚，星星划过elohi，可是拉长时间看，都留在圆形路径上。从去年夏天到现在，哪里也没去。

source: Brave Wind: Well, what if we also are wagadv, bound, like the stars? Moving here and there each day, but in greater time, we travel a circle-path we cannot see?
target: 勇风：那，若我们也像星星一样，都是wagadv，被绑住呢？每天到处走，可拉长时间看，只是在走看不见的圆圈？

source: Brave Wind: Pssh, tohitsu – I’m fine. Look, I can flick your ear in the dark…
target: 勇风：啧，tohitsu，我很好。看，黑暗里也能弹你耳朵……

source: Good Nose: Errm… no.
target: 好鼻：呃……没有。

source: Brave Wind: Oh father, it was ulosvsdi – most terrible. An insult to the great Creator! I watched as beaver was skinned and his flesh and heart were strewn on the ground. The three spirits did not thank the Creator but laughed as they tossed beaver’s skin into a sack with other pelts. They kill with ulihelisdi, with gladness! What if they find—
target: 勇风：父亲，那是ulosvsdi，太可怕了！侮辱伟大的造物主！我看着河狸被剥皮，肉和心丢在地上。三个鬼魂没有感谢造物主，反而笑着，把皮扔进装满其他皮毛的袋子。他们带着ulihelisdi，带着欢喜杀戮！要是找到——

source: Brave Wind: We must… sharpen our… tomahawks! Summon… the warriors!
target: 勇风：得……磨利……战斧！召集……战士！

source: Plenty Birds: What did they want of brother beaver?
target: 群鸟：他们要河狸兄弟的什么？

source: Plenty Birds: Uwetsi – my son. Fill your chest. Speak slowly.
target: 群鸟：Uwetsi，我的儿子。吸满气，慢慢说。

source: Brave Wind: I saw spirits. Three. By amadahy creek. Walking in the shape of men, with pale skin the color of bone, but they did not move with sickness. Their mouths were covered by thick, long hair like a bison’s and they wore woven clothes and spoke in strange sounds. Edoda, I cannot even shape the sounds with my own tongue. And they carried sticks of… some sort of ulanigidv – like magic. They pointed them at brother beaver, who was killed after the sticks released a mighty crack. The sound was vast and filled the pines – it reminded me of a great rock falling from a cliff and splitting in—
target: 勇风：我看见鬼魂，三个，在amadahy溪边。人形行走，皮肤白得像骨，却不带病态。嘴被野牛般浓长的毛遮住，穿编织衣，说怪声音。Edoda，我的舌头连模仿都做不到。他们拿着棍子，某种ulanigidv，像魔法。指向河狸兄弟，棍子巨响，河狸便死了。声音巨大，充满松林，像巨石落崖裂成——

source: Plenty Birds: Enough, boy! Fear spreads like fire on dry pine. Keep fear in your heart. Do not speak on this anymore until we sit before uku, our chief. Come, we will go to the bark lodge and meet him now. You will tell the chief what you saw, and you will speak like a man, slow and strong.
target: 群鸟：够了，孩子！恐惧像干松上的火，传得飞快。藏在心里。在见uku，我们的首领之前，别再说。来，现在去树皮屋见他。告诉首领所见，像男人那样，慢而有力地说。

source: Plenty Birds: Sha! It’s late in the night, why do you yip like coyote?
target: 群鸟：嘘！夜深了，为何像郊狼叫？
